_options: stats, weight and height each accept: additive, highest, or vanilla. vanilla turns that option off.
_stats: Your Strike Supers and Ki Blast Supers investment, gear included. additive = each stat also gets the other's. highest = both stats use whichever of the two is better.
_weight: Your Weight body type. highest = every character gets the best Weight tier on both stats, so Weight no longer decides your damage. additive behaves the same here.
_height: Your Height body type. highest = every character gets the best Height tier's health, up to about 7 percent more, added on top of their own. Speed is not changed.
_share: How much of the other stat is handed across. 1.0 = all of it, 0.5 = half, 0 = none. Applies to stats; weight and height are all-or-nothing.
_soft_cap_points: Diminishing returns begin once a stat's combined total passes this many attribute points. 200 is the most the game lets you invest in a single stat.
_falloff: How much of everything past the soft cap still counts. 0 = hard cap, 1 = no diminishing returns.
_logging: true writes combined_supers.log and combined_supers_status.txt into this folder. Off by default.
_buffs: Transformations and super souls are never combined. A +20 percent super soul stays +20 percent.
_negative: Negative gear counts like the game counts it. With additive stats a penalty is shared across too, so one stat can end up slightly below vanilla.
_multiplayer: Everyone playing together should use the same config file, or you will disagree about damage.
